title: The library photograph exhibition
paragraphs: Riko found {{1}} envelope of old photographs inside a library drawer. {{2}} contained images of the town before the new bridge was built.
The librarian explained that a local teacher {{3}} donated the collection decades earlier. Each photograph was labelled {{4}} a date and place, {{5}} several names had faded.
Riko created a display, {{6}} attracted former residents to the library. He waited {{7}} they identified the missing people, then recorded what {{8}} remembered.
